correctness.rationale: The complete finite domains for two and three pairs are exhaustively enumerated. For each profile, two independent blocking-pair implementations agree on the full stable-matching set, after which egalitarian and regret argmins are computed by exact integer rank comparisons. The \(4\times4\) witness is independently checked over all twenty-four perfect matchings and has exactly the two stated stable matchings with objective pairs \((15,3)\) and \((13,4)\).

value.rationale: Egalitarian and minimum-regret stable matchings are canonical fairness objectives measuring total rank burden and worst individual burden. The smallest size at which they can force incompatible stable choices is a natural structural invariant. Universal nesting through three pairs, the full relation census, and an explicit sharp four-pair separation jointly provide a meaningful boundary rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
